name: Custom Characters & Custom Attacks Pack
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 5 playable Mega, Primal, and Battle Bond forms with 10 signature custom attacks, 5 Ultimates, and drop-in character support.
description: Adds 5 iconic special forms into the Custom playable roster (#2001-#2005): Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, and Ash-Greninja. Every fighter comes with tailored stats, animated sprites, 2 dedicated signature custom attacks (10 total), a custom Ultimate, and 3 custom Pokéball pickup items. Also supports dropping your own standalone character .json and .png files into ./characters/.
highlights: 5 playable special forms: Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, and Ash-Greninja
10 signature custom attacks including Delta Dragon Ascent, Precipice Blades, Origin Pulse, Psystrike, and Bond Water Shuriken
5 custom signature Ultimates and 3 custom Pokéball pickup items
Drop-in ./characters/ folder support for adding your own custom fighters without creating a separate mod
requirements: Offline Mode + Hyrule's Mods (Custom Characters Enabler)
